title: Create a photorealistic two-photo vertic
prompt: Create a photorealistic two-photo vertical split collage of the same adult East Asian woman in soft romantic fashion, designed as eye-soothing social media AI art. Canvas: square 1:1 image, divided into exactly 2 equal side-by-side panels with no visible border, warm indoor lighting, high-detail smartphone-photo realism, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field, cozy feminine mood. Left panel: the woman is seated at a small cafe table at night, looking down and to her left with a calm expression, dark hair in a loose messy updo with wispy bangs, wearing a pale blue-gray lace and knit cutout coquette outfit with crisscross halter straps, long distressed lace sleeves, small bow ties, a ruffled cream mini skirt, and delicate necklace; include exactly 2 visible cafe items on the table: 1 iced latte in a clear glass with black straw and 1 slice of layered berry cake on a blue-patterned plate with a spoon. Background shows a dark window, a white wall, shelves or counter decor, and dried flowers in a vase. Right panel: the woman stands in front of a mirror taking a phone selfie, looking at the phone screen, long dark wavy hair with bangs, wearing a lavender purple floral sheer ruffled coquette set with off-shoulder translucent sleeves, lace-up bodice, ribbon details, and a short layered ruffle skirt; she holds a light-colored smartphone with a cute cat sticker on the case. Background shows a dark restroom or fitting-room door, tiled wall, hexagon floor tiles at the bottom, and a Japanese-style wall sign. Overall styling: soft glossy beauty photography, delicate pastel colors, romantic lace textures, subtle film grain, realistic reflections, flattering composition, no watermark, no extra people, no distorted hands or faces. Use an adult East Asian woman, pale blue-gray, lavender purple, warm cozy nighttime cafe and mirror selfie, and photorealistic smartphone fashion collage.
